text: D-026 (owner's rule): a line is one kind; an item taken out instantiates with details; put back it lists beside the nameless quantity, not merged; unexamined entries are marked visually. D-027 B: search per compartment, time from volume, menus fast to traverse. The item review's model is implied -> line -> thing; lines are arrays, things are entities.
Scope split with PEO-053 recorded on PEO-053: 050 is read-through, instantiate, put-back, quality sampling and the cap; 053 is generation.
